columns.description: Performance obligation line split unique identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a source document line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the source document subline.

columns.name: REVENUE_SPLIT_PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of the revenue split line.

columns.name: REVENUE_SPLIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revenue amount for the split line.

columns.name: REVENUE_SPLIT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the split of a performance obligation line are created.

columns.name: REVENUE_ACCOUNT_CCID

columns.name: BU_ID

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Manually entered comments for the revenue line split.
